arXiv:2605.10817v1 [cs.AI] 2026 年 5 月 11 日arXiv:2605.10817v1 [cs.AI] 11 May 2026

CLEF：脑电图基础模型CLEF: EEG Foundation Model
用于学习临床语义for Learning Clinical Semantics

Peng Cao*1  Ali Mirzazadeh*1
 Jong Woo Lee2  Aleksandar Videnovic3  Dina Katabi 1

1 MIT CSAIL  2 Brigham and Women’s Hospital, Harvard Medical School
3 Massachusetts General Hospital, Harvard Medical School
摘要Abstract

临床脑电图解释需要对完整的脑电图会话进行推理，并将信号模式与临床背景相结合。现有的脑电图基础模型主要是为短窗口解码而设计的，不包含临床背景。我们介绍 CLEF，一种基于临床的长上下文脑电图基础模型。 CLEF 将 EEG 会话表示为 3D 多锥度频谱图标记，从而在会话规模上实现易于处理的 Transformer 建模，并通过对比目标将嵌入与神经科医生报告和结构化 EHR 数据保持一致。我们根据一个新的 234 项任务基准评估 CLEF，该基准涵盖疾病表型、药物暴露和脑电图结果，来自超过 108,000 名患者的超过 260,000 次脑电图检查。 CLEF 在 234 项任务中的 229 项上优于之前的 EEG 基础模型，将平均 AUROC 从 0.65 提高到 0.74。仅重建预训练超越了之前的脑电图基础模型，而报告和电子病历对齐产生了进一步的收益。保留概念和外部队列实验表明，这些表征转移超出了观察到的对齐目标。这些结果支持会话规模、临床基础的表示学习作为临床脑电图有前途的基础模型范式。Clinical EEG interpretation requires reasoning over full EEG sessions and integrating signal patterns with clinical context. Existing EEG foundation models are largely designed for short-window decoding and do not incorporate clinical context. We introduce CLEF, a clinically grounded long-context EEG foundation model. CLEF represents EEG sessions as 3D multitaper spectrogram tokens, enabling tractable Transformer modeling at session scale, and aligns embeddings with neurologist reports and structured EHR data through contrastive objectives. We evaluate CLEF on a new 234-task benchmark spanning disease phenotypes, medication exposures, and EEG findings, with more than 260k EEG sessions from over 108k patients. CLEF outperforms prior EEG foundation models on 229 of 234 tasks, improving mean AUROC from 0.65 to 0.74. Reconstruction-only pretraining surpasses prior EEG foundation models, while report and EHR alignment yields further gains. Held-out concept and external-cohort experiments suggest that these representations transfer beyond observed alignment targets. These results support session-scale, clinically grounded representation learning as a promising foundation-model paradigm for clinical EEG.

1 简介Introduction

脑电图（EEG）是临床神经科学的基石。通过记录头皮的电活动，脑电图提供了一个了解大脑功能的非侵入性窗口，通常用于诊断癫痫、表征脑病、监测神经功能恶化、评估药物效果以及开发神经和精神疾病的生物标志物。美国每年进行超过 100 万次临床脑电图检查，但高达 75% 的结果是由未经神经生理学培训的临床医生解读的Electroencephalography (EEG) is a cornerstone of clinical neuroscience. By recording electrical activity from the scalp, EEG provides a non-invasive window into brain function and is routinely used to diagnose epilepsy, characterize encephalopathy, monitor neurological deterioration, assess medication effects, and develop biomarkers for neurological and psychiatric diseases. Over one million clinical EEGs are performed annually in the US, yet up to 75% are interpreted by clinicians without neurophysiology training[32]。这一差距激发了自动化系统从脑电图中提取有临床意义的信息并使专家级神经生理学评估民主化。. This gap motivates automated systems that extract clinically meaningful information from EEG and democratize expert-level neurophysiological assessment.

尽管近年来脑电图基础模型取得了快速进展Though recent years have seen rapid progress in EEG foundation models[18, 6, 8, 17, 5, 39, 38, 47, 44, 24]，这些模型是受到脑机接口（BCI）研究的启发。他们的目标是从神经活动的短暂窗口中解码瞬时大脑状态（例如，运动意图、情绪反应、感知刺激）。因此，它们通常对较短的脑电图片段（通常为 5-30 秒长）进行操作，并通过掩蔽重建、对比学习、自回归预测或相关的自监督目标来学习脑电图信号本身的表示。这种范例对于短窗口解码非常有效。然而，这并不是临床脑电图使用的范式。, these models are motivated by brain–computer interface (BCI) research. Their goal is to decode an instantaneous brain state (e.g., a motor intention, an emotional response, a perceived stimulus) from a brief window of neural activity. Accordingly, they typically operate on short EEG segments, often 5–30 seconds long, and learn representations from the EEG signal itself through masked reconstruction, contrastive learning, autoregressive prediction, or related self-supervised objectives. This paradigm has been highly effective for short-window decoding. However, it is not the paradigm used in clinical EEG.

临床脑电图的解释是根本不同的。神经科医生不会解读 10 秒片段的脑电图；他们检查整个录音过程（通常为 20 分钟或更长时间），并整合随时间重复、持续、演变或波动的模式Clinical EEG interpretation is fundamentally different. Neurologists do not interpret an EEG from a 10-second segment; they examine an entire recording session, typically 20 minutes or longer, and integrate patterns that recur, persist, evolve, or fluctuate over time[31]。癫痫样异常不仅可以通过个体放电的形态来评估，还可以通过其复发和演变来评估。脑病、药物效应和全身性疾病通常表现为背景组织、减慢、周期性或睡眠-觉醒结构的更广泛变化，而不是孤立的局部波形。临床脑电图也会在上下文中进行解释，结合研究的适应症、药物、诊断和更广泛的病史. Epileptiform abnormalities are assessed not only by the morphology of individual discharges, but also by their recurrence and evolution. Encephalopathy, medication effects, and systemic illness often appear as broader changes in background organization, slowing, periodicity, or sleep-wake structure rather than as isolated local waveforms. Clinical EEG is also interpreted in context, incorporating the indication for the study, medications, diagnoses, and broader medical history[33]。因此，临床脑电图的基础模型应该代表其临床背景下的整个会话，而不仅仅是一小段。. Accordingly, a foundation model for clinical EEG should represent an entire session in its clinical context, rather than only short segments.

我们介绍We introduceCLEF, 一个, aCL伊尼卡inicalEEG F基础模型建立在两个原则之上：oundation model built on two principles:长上下文建模long-context modeling在完整的脑电图会议的规模上，以及at the scale of a full EEG session, and临床语义学基础grounding in clinical semantics。将脑电图基础模型从几秒钟扩展到整个会话不仅仅是增加上下文长度。标准 19 通道、200 Hz、1280 秒记录包含近 500 万个原始样本，使得直接长上下文波形建模的计算成本很高。此外，直接在长窗口上建模脑电图波形在统计上是不恰当的，因为正在进行的脑电图被充分描述为非平稳随机过程，其瞬时相位在重复记录中几乎没有携带可重复的信息，而其二阶谱结构相对稳定，并且是神经科医生从迹线中读取的内容. Extending EEG foundation models from seconds to full sessions is not merely increasing context length. A standard 19-channel, 200 Hz, 1280-second recording contains nearly five million raw samples, making direct long-context waveform modeling computationally expensive. Furthermore, modeling EEG waveforms directly over long windows is statistically ill-posed since ongoing EEG is well-described as a non-stationary stochastic process whose instantaneous phase carries little reproducible information across repeated recordings, while its second-order spectral structure is comparatively stable and is what neurologists read off the trace[7, 4, 21]。同一患者在相同条件下的两个记录共享频谱内容，但瞬时波形形状完全不同。 CLEF 通过对多锥度谱图进行操作解决了这些问题. Two recordings from the same patient under identical conditions share spectral content but differ entirely in instantaneous waveform shape. CLEF resolves these issues by operating on multitaper spectrograms[36]，它丢弃相位并对光谱特征进行编码。为了管理生成的数据量，CLEF 通过 VQGAN 对多通道频谱图进行标记, which discard phase and encode the spectral features. To manage the resulting data volume CLEF tokenizes the multi-channel spectrogram via a VQGAN[12]对所有通道进行联合编码，将完整会话压缩为 2,048 个令牌，并使会话规模的 Transformer 建模变得易于处理。that encodes all channels jointly, compressing a full session into 2,048 tokens, and making session-scale Transformer modeling tractable.

仅长上下文建模无法恢复重要的临床语义。无论患者是否患有阿尔茨海默氏病，还是正在接受吗啡治疗，都会在脑电图上产生信号，但恢复这些信号需要以编码该信息的临床模式为基础。 CLEF 通过对称对比目标将记录级嵌入与两种此类模式对齐Long-context modeling alone cannot recover important clinical semantics. Whether a patient carries a diagnosis of Alzheimer’s disease or is being treated with morphine produces signatures in the EEG, but recovering them requires grounding in the clinical modalities that encode this information. CLEF aligns the recording-level embedding with two such modalities through symmetric contrastive objectives[27]：自由文本神经科医生报告，由法学硕士摘要器进行预处理，以保留电图内容和结构化电子健康记录 (EHR) 数据，该数据通过人口统计、活性药物和编码为可变长度的学习代码嵌入集的诊断来总结患者更广泛的临床概况。报告和 EHR 共同确保脑电图表示以医生使用的临床语义为基础。: free-text neurologist reports, preprocessed by an LLM summarizer to preserve electrographic content, and structured electronic health record (EHR) data, which summarizes the patient’s broader clinical profile through demographics, active medications, and diagnoses encoded as a variable-length set of learned code embeddings. Together, reports and EHRs ensure EEG representations are grounded in the clinical semantics used by physicians.

进一步的挑战是评估。现有的 EEG 基准侧重于短段 BCI 任务，而不是患者级别的临床任务。因此，我们从哈佛脑电图数据库 (HEEDB) 中策划了广泛的临床脑电图基准，该数据库是一个大型多医院资源，包含来自 108,000 多名患者的 260,000 多个脑电图记录，其中许多记录与未识别的神经生理学报告和 EHR 数据相关A further challenge is evaluation. Existing EEG benchmarks focus on short-segment BCI tasks, rather than patient-level clinical tasks. We therefore curate a broad clinical EEG benchmark from the Harvard Electroencephalography Database (HEEDB), a large multi-hospital resource containing over 260,000 EEG recordings from more than 108,000 patients, many linked to deidentified neurophysiology reports and EHR data[32]。我们构建了 234 个下游分类任务，涵盖三个临床轴：疾病表型、药物暴露和有临床意义的脑电图特征。. We construct 234 downstream classification tasks spanning three clinical axes: disease phenotypes, medication exposures, and clinically meaningful EEG features.

根据经验，CLEF 为临床脑电图建立了强大的基础模型。在 234 项任务基准中，CLEF 在 234 项任务中的 229 项上优于最新的 EEG 基础模型基线，将平均 AUROC 从最强基线的 0.65 提高到 0.74，如图 1 所示。Empirically, CLEF establishes a strong foundation model for clinical EEG. Across the 234-task benchmark, CLEF outperforms recent EEG foundation model baselines on 229 of 234 tasks, improving mean AUROC from 0.65 for the strongest baseline to 0.74, as summarized in Fig.1。重要的是，CLEF 的绩效提升适用于未出现在用于培训的报告或 EHR 中的新疾病和药物。它们还传输到训练期间看不见的外部数据集。消融表明，仅重建预训练已经产生了比之前的脑电图基础模型更强的表征，而临床报告和 EHR 对齐提供了额外的增益，支持了临床脑电图基础模型受益于会话规模信号建模和临床基础的中心假设。. Importantly, CLEF’s performance gains generalize to new diseases and medications that do not appear in the reports or EHRs used for training. They also transfer to external datasets unseen during training. Ablations show that reconstruction-only pretraining already yields representations stronger than prior EEG foundation models, while clinical report and EHR alignment provide additional gains, supporting the central hypothesis that clinical EEG foundation models benefit from both session-scale signal modeling and clinical grounding.

我们的贡献是：Our contributions are:

  • •

    我们制定We formulate临床脑电图基础建模clinical EEG foundation modeling作为从完整的脑电图会话中学习的患者级表征，而不是短窗口信号解码。as patient-level representation learning from full EEG sessions, rather than short-window signal decoding.

  • •

    我们引入了 CLEF，这是一种基于临床的长上下文 EEG 基础模型，它使用多通道频谱图标记，并将会话级表示与 EEG 报告和结构化 EHR 数据保持一致。We introduce CLEF, a clinically-grounded long-context EEG foundation model that uses multi-channel spectrogram tokens and aligns session-level representations with EEG reports and structured EHR data.

  • •

    我们策划了一个包含 234 项任务的临床脑电图基准，涵盖疾病表型、药物暴露和脑电图结果，从而能够系统评估脑电图表征是否捕获有临床意义的信息。We curate a 234-task clinical EEG benchmark spanning disease phenotypes, medication exposures, and EEG findings, enabling systematic evaluation of whether EEG representations capture clinically meaningful information.

  • •

    我们表明，CLEF 在整个基准测试中优于先前的 EEG 基础模型，并可推广到多个外部数据集，建立完整的、基于临床的 EEG 表示学习作为可基准测试的基础模型问题。We show that CLEF outperforms prior EEG foundation models across the benchmark and generalizes to multiple external datasets, establishing full-session, clinically grounded EEG representation learning as a benchmarkable foundation-model problem.

2 相关工作Related Work

脑电图基础模型。EEG Foundation Models.基础模型方法最近已通过对比学习、掩模重建和自回归预测应用于脑电图Foundation-model methods have recently been adapted to EEG through contrastive learning, masked reconstruction, and autoregressive prediction[18, 6, 8, 17, 5, 39, 38, 47, 44, 24]。代表性模型包括 LaBraM，它学习离散神经标记以进行掩蔽建模. Representative models include LaBraM, which learns discrete neural tokens for masked modeling[17]; CBraMod，使用十字形变压器对空间和时间结构进行建模; CBraMod, which models spatial and temporal structure with a criss-cross transformer[39];和 REVE，它强调通过大规模预训练的异构电极蒙太奇的鲁棒性; and REVE, which emphasizes robustness across heterogeneous electrode montages with large-scale pretraining[24]。这些模型具有显着先进的脑电图表示学习，但它们主要是为 BCI 风格的设置而设计的：从神经活动的短窗口（通常为几秒长）解码标签。临床脑电图解释提出了不同的表征学习问题。神经科医生检查完整的记录过程，整合随时间重复或演变的模式，并在临床背景下解释信号。因此，CLEF 在时间尺度和监督方面都背离了之前的 EEG 基础模型：它从完整的 EEG 会话中学习患者级别的表征，并将其基于临床语义，而不是仅依赖于信号内在目标。. These models have substantially advanced EEG representation learning, but they are primarily designed for the BCI-style setting: decoding labels from short windows of neural activity, typically a few seconds long. Clinical EEG interpretation poses a different representation-learning problem. Neurologists examine full recording sessions, integrate patterns that recur or evolve over time, and interpret the signal in clinical context. CLEF therefore departs from prior EEG foundation models in both temporal scale and supervision: it learns patient-level representations from full EEG sessions and grounds them in clinical semantics rather than relying only on signal-intrinsic objectives.

多模式临床表征学习。Multimodal Clinical Representation Learning.从 CLIP 中的图像文本对齐开始，对比多模态学习已成为学习可转移表示的强大方法Contrastive multimodal learning has become a powerful approach for learning transferable representations, beginning with image–text alignment in CLIP[27]并通过将临床图像与报告或生物医学文本对齐扩展到医学领域and extending to medical domains through alignment of clinical images with reports or biomedical text[46, 37, 45, 11]。在脑电图中，多模态学习主要集中在感知或任务驱动的设置上，例如从大脑活动中解码文本，将脑电图与视觉语言嵌入对齐，或者使用语言来统一短段脑电图任务. In EEG, multimodal learning has mainly focused on perceptual or task-driven settings, such as decoding text from brain activity, aligning EEG with visual-language embeddings, or using language to unify short-segment EEG tasks[40, 10, 20, 16]。相反，CLEF 使用多模式学习来进行临床基础。神经科医生报告提供了电图检查结果的专家描述，而电子病历数据提供了有关诊断、药物和人口统计的补充信息。 将全会话 EEG 嵌入与这两种模式保持一致，使 CLEF 能够学习围绕 EEG 解释中使用的临床概念组织的表示。据我们所知，先前的脑电图基础模型尚未将会话规模建模与报告和 EHR 对齐相结合，以进行患者级临床脑电图表征学习。. CLEF instead uses multimodal learning for clinical grounding. Neurologist reports provide expert descriptions of electrographic findings, while EHR data provide complementary information about diagnoses, medications, and demographics. Aligning full-session EEG embeddings with these two modalities allows CLEF to learn representations organized around the clinical concepts used in EEG interpretation. To our knowledge, prior EEG foundation models have not combined session-scale modeling with report and EHR alignment for patient-level clinical EEG representation learning.

3 方法Method

CLEF 建立在两个原则之上：CLEF is built on the two principles:长上下文建模long-context modeling在完整的脑电图会议的规模上，以及at the scale of a full EEG session, and临床语义学基础grounding in clinical semantics。这些映射到两级管道上（图. These map onto a two-stage pipeline (Figure2）。第一阶段通过掩模重建学习 3D 紧凑谱时标记表示，使会话规模建模变得易于处理。第二阶段通过将其与两种临床模式（自由文本神经科医生报告和结构化 EHR 数据）保持一致，将由此产生的患者级别嵌入临床意义。下面介绍的设计选择在附录中得到了实证验证). Stage I makes session-scale modeling tractable by learning a 3D compact spectro-temporal token representation through masked reconstruction. Stage II grounds the resulting patient-level embedding in clinical meaning by aligning it with two clinical modalities: free-text neurologist reports and structured EHR data. The design choices introduced below are validated empirically in AppendixD.

3.1 第一阶段：会话规模掩模重建Stage I: Session-Scale Masked Reconstruction

一段 20 分钟的脑电图记录包含近 500 万个原始样本。此外，脑电图的瞬时相位在很大程度上是随机的，因此同一患者在相同条件下的两个记录共享频谱内容，但波形存在显着差异。第一阶段解决这两个问题。我们首先通过多锥度频谱图进入时频域，它丢弃相位，同时保留神经学家实际解释的频谱特征（睡眠纺锤波、减慢、阿尔法节律），并产生比原始波形更稳定的局部统计数据。我们转换脑电图记录的每个通道A 20-minute session of EEG recording contains nearly five million raw samples. In addition, the instantaneous phase of EEG is largely stochastic, so two recordings from the same patient under identical conditions share spectral content but differ significantly in waveform. Stage I addresses both issues. We first move into the time-frequency domain via multitaper spectrogram, which discards phase while preserving the spectral features neurologists actually interpret (sleep spindles, slowing, alpha rhythms), and yields more stationary local statistics than the raw waveform. We convert each channel of an EEG recording𝐗∈ℝC×T\mathbf{X}\in\mathbb{R}^{C\times T}到对数幅度多锥谱图to a log-magnitude multitaper spectrogram[36]在临床相关的 0–32 Hz 频段上，产生over the clinically relevant 0–32 Hz band, yielding𝐒∈ℝC×H×W\mathbf{S}\in\mathbb{R}^{C\times H\times W}与withC=19C{=}19渠道，channels,H=128H{=}128频率档（0.25 Hz 分辨率），以及frequency bins (0.25 Hz resolution), andW=2,048W{=}2{,}048跨越 1,280 秒会话的时间范围。 Even after this transform, a session-scale spectrogram remains too large to feed directly into a Transformer;因此，第一阶段学习离散分词器，将多通道频谱图压缩为短的 3D 代码序列，并对 EEG 编码器进行预训练以预测屏蔽代码。time frames spanning a 1,280-second session. Even after this transform, a session-scale spectrogram remains too large to feed directly into a Transformer; Stage I therefore learns a discrete tokenizer that compresses the multi-channel spectrogram into a short sequence of 3D codes, and pretrains the EEG encoder to predict masked codes.

3.2 第二阶段：报告和 EHR 的跨模式协调Stage II: Cross-Modal Alignment with Report and EHR

第一阶段为我们提供了一个会话规模的编码器，但仅信号预训练无法恢复脑电图中不直接可见的临床语义。例如，患者是否患有阿尔茨海默病，会在录音中留下签名，但学习阅读这些签名需要编码该信息的模式的监督。因此，第二阶段调整了患者级别的嵌入Stage I gives us a session-scale encoder, but signal-only pretraining cannot recover clinical semantics that are not directly visible in the EEG. For example, whether a patient carries a diagnosis of Alzheimer’s disease leaves signatures in the recording, but learning to read them requires supervision from the modalities that encode this information. Stage II therefore aligns the patient-level embedding𝐮∈ℝd\mathbf{u}\in\mathbb{R}^{d}有两种互补的临床模式：with two complementary clinical modalities:自由文本神经科医生报告free-text neurologist reports，捕捉录音本身的专家解释，以及, which capture expert interpretation of the recording itself, and结构化 EHR 数据structured EHR data，描述了患者更广泛的临床状态。我们项目, which describe the patient’s broader clinical state. 3.2.1 与自由文本报告保持一致Alignment with Free-Text Reports

原始脑电图报告不能直接由文本编码器获取：单个报告可能跨越数千个标记，并将半模板化部分（患者病史、记录程序和参数）与自由散文（临床印象、建议）交织在一起，其中大部分与电图内容无关。直接编码产生的嵌入以样板文件为主，并且报告的长度使得它们无法与标准文本编码器进行对比对齐。因此，我们使用法学硕士摘要器对它们进行预处理，这提出了一个实际问题：在提示和输出长度的许多合理组合中，哪个最好地保留临床内容？Raw EEG reports are not directly ingestible by a text encoder: a single report may span several thousand tokens and interleave semi-templated sections (patient history, recording procedure and parameters) with free prose (clinical impression, recommendations), much of it irrelevant to the electrographic content. Direct encoding yields embeddings dominated by boilerplate, and reports’ length makes them impractical for contrastive alignment with standard text encoders. We therefore preprocess them with an LLM summarizer, which raises a practical question: among the many plausible combinations of prompt and output length, which best preserves the clinical content?

我们通过基于以下特征的自动选择管道来回答这个问题We answer this question with an automated selection pipeline based on aQA-一致性分数QA-consistency score（详情见附录(details in AppendixB.1）。让). 3.2.2 与结构化 EHR 保持一致Alignment with Structured EHR

电子健康记录 (EHR) 提供了该报告的补充视图：它不是解释当前记录，而是通过人口统计、药物和诊断的表格条目描述患者的整体临床概况。这些数据应该如何呈现给编码器？自然的尝试是将记录序列化为句子（例如，“65 岁女性，服用左乙拉西坦和异丙酚，有癫痫和慢性肾病病史……”）并使用文本编码器。然而，表格电子病历是来自受控词汇表的无序代码集。序列化强加了变压器将视为信息性的任意顺序，并将每个代码分割成编码器必须学会重新组合的子字片段，从而浪费了容量和计算量。The Electronic Health Record (EHR) provides a complementary view to the report: rather than interpreting the current recording, it describes the patient’s overall clinical profile through tabular entries for demographics, medications, and diagnoses. How should such data be presented to a encoder? A natural attempt is to serialize the record into a sentence (e.g., “65-year-old female, on levetiracetam and propofol, with a history of epilepsy and chronic kidney disease…”) and use a text encoder. However, tabular EHRs are unordered sets of codes from controlled vocabularies. Serialization imposes an arbitrary order that the transformer would treat as informative, and splits each code into subword pieces the encoder must learn to regroup, wasting capacity and compute.

相反，我们根据 EHR 的原生结构对其进行编码。每个患者都是来自三个来源的一组离散条目：We instead encode the EHR according to its native structure. Each patient is a set of discrete entries from three sources: a人口统计demographic小组作业（年龄段、性别、种族），一组group assignment (age bucket, sex, race), a set of药物代码medication codes，以及一组, and a set of诊断代码diagnosis codes。我们维护可学习的密码本. We maintain learnable codebooks𝐄med∈ℝKmed×d\mathbf{E}_{\text{med}}\in\mathbb{R}^{K_{\text{med}}\times d}和and𝐄dx∈ℝKdx×d\mathbf{E}_{\text{dx}}\in\mathbb{R}^{K_{\text{dx}}\times d}每个不同的代码有一个条目，加上人口统计代码簿with one entry per distinct code, plus demographic codebooks𝐄age,𝐄sex,𝐄race\mathbf{E}_{\text{age}},\mathbf{E}_{\text{sex}},\mathbf{E}_{\text{race}}每组一个条目。该设计通过以下方式表示每个代码with one entry per group. This design represents each code by身份identity它不是子词，而是学习针对 EEG 信号的端到端嵌入，以便临床相关的代码可以自行组织，并且通过构造实现排列不变，匹配数据的集合语义。rather than subwords, learns embeddings end-to-end against the EEG signal so clinically related codes can organize themselves, and is permutation-invariant by construction, matching the set semantics of the data.

3.2.3 培训计划Training Scheme

第一阶段和第二阶段按顺序进行训练：我们首先训练编码器Stages I and II are trained sequentially: we first train the encoder withℒRecon\mathcal{L}_{\text{Recon}}收敛，然后继续训练to convergence, then continue training it withℒAlign\mathcal{L}_{\text{Align}}，因为这两个目标在不同的抽象级别上运行：掩蔽重建是一个密集的位置级目标，迫使编码器捕获记录的内在谱时结构，而对比损失提供了稀疏的序列级信号，当这种结构存在时，该信号提供的信息更丰富。在这两个阶段中，我们从编码器输入中随机删除一小部分标记，以实现正则化和效率, because the two objectives operate at different levels of abstraction: Masked reconstruction is a dense, position-level objective that forces the encoder to capture the intrinsic spectro-temporal structure of the recording, whereas the contrastive losses provide a sparse, sequence-level signal that is more informative when such structure exists. Throughout both stages, we randomly drop a fraction of tokens from the encoder input for regularization and efficiency[19]，并应用随机通道掩蔽以使编码器暴露于部分剪辑条件。, and apply random channel masking to expose the encoder to partial-montage conditions.

4 实验Experiments

我们评估 CLEF 的学习表征是否捕获了 通过广泛的探测获得具有临床意义的信息 下游任务。自始至终，编码器都被冻结 预训练和轻量级探测头在顶部训练 每个任务的患者级嵌入，隔离任务的质量 从特定于任务的微调中学习到的表示。我们比较 CLEF 与相同条件下最先进的 EEG 基础模型 探测和聚合协议。模型和训练的实施细节在附录中提供We evaluate whether CLEF’s learned representations capture clinically meaningful information by probing on a broad suite of downstream tasks. Throughout, the encoder is frozen after pretraining and a lightweight probing head is trained on top of the patient-level embeddings for each task, isolating the quality of the learned representation from task-specific finetuning. We compare CLEF against state-of-the-art EEG foundation models under identical probing and aggregation protocols. Implementation details of model and training are provided in AppendixC.

4.1 数据集和基准Datasets and Benchmark

预训练。Pretraining.我们在哈佛的快照上预训练 CLEF 脑电图数据库（HEEDB）We pretrain CLEF on a snapshot of the Harvard Electroencephalography Database (HEEDB)[32]，包括 来自 108,341 名患者的 EHR 数据的 260,604 条记录，总计 200 万小时，其中 59.3% 链接神经科医生的报告。患者被分为 80/10/10 训练/验证/测试，保留同一患者的所有会话 在同一个分裂中。预训练和下游基准评估使用相同的分割，因此在预训练期间看不到测试患者。, comprising 260,604 recordings totaling 2M hours from 108,341 patients with EHR data, of which 59.3% have linked neurologist reports. Patients are split 80/10/10 into train/validation/test, with all sessions from the same patient kept in the same split. The same split is used for both pretraining and downstream benchmark evaluation, so no test patient is seen during pretraining.

基准。Benchmark.我们从 HEEDB 构建 234 个患者级别的二元分类任务 跨越临床意义的三个轴：(i) 源自 ICD-10 代码的 120 种疾病表型任务，分为 phecodesWe construct 234 patient-level binary classification tasks from HEEDB spanning three axes of clinical meaning: (i) 120 disease phenotypes tasks derived from ICD-10 codes grouped into phecodes[9], (ii) 99 个药物暴露任务源自映射到 ATC 的处方记录 代码, (ii) 99 medication exposures tasks derived from prescription records mapped to ATC codes[41]，以及 (iii) 15 个脑电图特征任务 摘自神经科医生的报告。对于每项任务，每个患者最多贡献 一个疗程，每个阳性病例最多 10 个对照, and (iii) 15 EEG feature tasks extracted from neurologist reports. For each task, each patient contributes at most one session, and up to 10 controls per positive case are匹配的matched上 年龄、性别、地点和记录环境（ICU、EMU、常规脑电图）以减少混淆。 基准建设的完整程序在 附录on age, sex, site, and recording setting (ICU, EMU, Routine EEG) to reduce confounding. Full procedures for benchmark construction are in AppendixB.2.

保留临床概念。Held-out clinical concepts.为了评估训练期间未见的新疾病、药物和脑电图特征的可转移性，我们进行了一项额外的预训练实验，其中随机选择基准中 20% 的任务，并从报告和 EHR 中删除相关术语。这个 产生了一套模型从未出现过的临床概念 在对齐过程中暴露于，使我们能够评估转移到 新颖的概念。To assess transferability to new diseases, medications, and EEG features unseen during training, we run an additional pretraining experiment in which 20% of the tasks in the benchmark are randomly selected and the relevant terms are removed from both reports and EHRs. This yields a held-out set of clinical concepts that the model has never been exposed to during alignment, allowing us to evaluate transfer to novel concepts.

外部队列。External cohorts.为了评估跨数据源和蒙太奇的概括性，我们评估了三个外部队列：来自 TUH EEG 语料库的 TUAB（异常脑电图检测）和 TUEP（癫痫检测）To assess generalization across data sources and montages, we evaluate on three external cohorts: TUAB (abnormal EEG detection) and TUEP (epilepsy detection) from the TUH EEG Corpus[23]，都是完整的蒙太奇； 2026 年 PhysioNet 挑战赛中的 HSP 和 HSP, both full-montage; and HSP from the PhysioNet Challenge 2026[25]，一个 6 通道认知障碍检测数据集。每个数据集在患者级别分为 75% 的训练和 25% 的测试，其中 15% 的训练数据用于验证，并在患者级别进行评估。, a 6-channel cognitive impairment detection dataset. Each dataset was split at patient level into 75% training and 25% test, with 15% of the training data held out for validation, and evaluated at patient level.

4.2 评估协议Evaluation Protocol

基线。Baselines.我们将 CLEF 与五种最先进的 EEG 基础模型进行比较，这些模型共同代表了大规模 EEG 预训练的领先方法：BIOTWe compare CLEF against five state-of-the-art EEG foundation models that collectively represent the leading approaches to large-scale EEG pretraining: BIOT[43]，一个经过异构通道配置训练的生物信号转换器；拉布拉姆, a biosignal transformer trained on heterogeneous channel configurations; LaBraM[17]，通过屏蔽神经代码预测预训练的大型大脑模型； CBraMod, a large brain model pretrained via masked neural code prediction; CBraMod[39]，它引入了交叉注意力来捕获时空依赖性；瑞维, which introduces criss-cross attention to capture spatial-temporal dependencies; REVE[24]，一种最新的编码器，专为强大的脑电图表示学习而设计；和神经LM, a recent encoder designed for robust EEG representation learning; and NeuroLM[15]，它将脑电图和语言建模统一在一个共享架构中。对于每个基线，我们在公开发布的预训练编码器之上进行探测。 NeuroLM 的指令调整检查点尚未发布，因此我们使用官方代码对其进行了重现。, which unifies EEG and language modeling within a shared architecture. For each baseline, we probe on top of the publicly released pretrained encoder. NeuroLM’s instruction-tuned checkpoint is not released, so we reproduced it using the official code.

试探。Probing.对于每项任务，我们在冻结的患者级嵌入上训练 2 层 MLP 头。为了确保所有方法都能看到相同的时间上下文，而不管其本机训练窗口如何，每个编码器都在整个会话中以滑动窗口的方式应用，并且生成的片段嵌入在传递到探针之前被平均池化为单个患者级嵌入。For each task, we train a 2-layer MLP head on the frozen patient-level embedding. To ensure that all methods see the same temporal context regardless of their native training window, every encoder is applied in a sliding-window fashion over the full session and the resulting segment embeddings are mean-pooled into a single patient-level embedding before being passed to the probe.

指标。Metrics.我们报告所有基准任务的 AUROC。对于 外部数据集，其中标签流行率不受控制，我们 还报告平衡准确性 (BACC) 以及决策阈值 在验证集上选择。重复探测实验 跨越 4 个种子来报告平均值和标准差。We report AUROC across all benchmark tasks. For external datasets, where label prevalence is not controlled, we also report balanced accuracy (BACC), with the decision threshold selected on validation set. Probing experiments are repeated across 4 seeds to report mean and standard deviation.

AppendixF详细说明每项任务的 AUROC。 CLEF 在所有类别中均显着优于基线。它在检测危重疾病、全身感染、脑血管和脑结构疾病以及止痛药、麻醉药、抗癫痫药和精神药物等药物暴露方面特别有效。各种疾病的性能大幅提升，包括脑瘫 (+0.27)、酒精性肝病 (+0.21)、阿尔茨海默病 (+0.16)、肝硬化 (+0.16)、脑水肿 (+0.12)。各种药物的表现增益包括吗啡 (+0.18)、唑尼沙胺 (+0.18)、氢吗啡酮 (+0.18)、氯巴扎姆 (+0.17)。details the AUROC for each task. CLEF significantly outperforms the baselines across all categories. It is particularly effective at detecting critical illnesses, systemic infections, and cerebrovascular and cerebrostructural diseases, as well as exposure to medications including analgesics, anesthetics, anti-epileptics, and psycholeptics. Large performance gain across diseases include Cerebral Palsy (+0.27), Alcoholic Liver Disease (+0.21), Alzheimer’s Disease (+0.16), Cirrhosis (+0.16), Cerebral Edema (+0.12). Performance gain across medications include Morphine (+0.18), Zonisamide (+0.18), Hydromorphone (+0.18), Clobazam (+0.17).

图Figure3还表明仅进行重建（即仅进行 I 期）的 CLEF 优于基线。这表明即使没有跨模式对齐，长上下文设计和第一阶段训练也是有价值的。为了进一步研究这一点，并且由于基线和 CLEF 均在不同的数据集上进行训练，因此我们重新训练 REVE，这是 EEG 基础模型的当前 SOTAalso shows that CLEF with reconstruction only (i.e., Stage I alone) outperforms the baselines. This indicates that the long-context design and Stage I training are valuable even without cross-modal alignment. To investigate this point further and since the baselines and CLEF each is trained on different datasets, we retrain REVE, the current SOTA for EEG foundation models[24]，在用于训练 CLEF 的同一数据集上。 AUROC 改进自, on the same dataset used for training CLEF. The AUROC improves from0.628±0.0170.628\pm 0.017 to 0.655±0.0140.655\pm 0.014，表明我们的基准测试中更大、更多样化的训练数据集有好处。然而，AUROC 仍显着低于 CLEF，仅在, indicating a benefit for the larger and more diverse training dataset in our benchmark. However, the AUROC stays significantly lower than both CLEF with reconstruction only at0.671±0.0080.671\pm 0.008，以及具有重建和跨模态对齐的 CLEF, and CLEF with both reconstruction and cross-modal alignment at0.737±0.0060.737\pm 0.006.

值得注意的是，一些任务仅通过重建就表现良好，而从报告和 EHR 中的临床语义对齐中获得的收益很少：异丙酚的 AUROC 为 0.905，缺氧性脑损伤为 0.899，跨模式对齐后分别达到 0.925 和 0.901，略有改善。这些标签可能对应于视觉上显着的脑电图模式，允许掩模重建学习已经支持强分类的特征。相比之下，跨模态对齐后，脑瘫从 0.711 改善到 0.881，曲唑酮从 0.640 改善到 0.806。这些较大的增益表明，报告和 EHR 对齐对于其 EEG 关联不能立即从 EEG 信号中清晰的标签特别有用。这种模式与临床实践一致：脑电图通常用于监测异丙酚效应和评估缺氧性脑损伤，但不用于诊断脑瘫或识别曲唑酮暴露Notably, some tasks perform well with reconstruction alone and gain little from alignment to clinical semantics in reports and EHRs: propofol reaches an AUROC of 0.905 and anoxic brain injury 0.899, with small improvements after cross-modal alignment to 0.925 and 0.901, respectively. These labels may correspond to visually salient EEG patterns, allowing masked reconstruction to learn features that already support strong classification. In contrast, cerebral palsy improves from 0.711 to 0.881 and trazodone from 0.640 to 0.806 after cross-modal alignment. These larger gains suggest that report and EHR alignment is particularly useful for labels whose EEG associations are not immediately clear from the EEG signal. This pattern is consistent with clinical practice: EEG is commonly used to monitor propofol effects and assess anoxic brain injury, but not for diagnosing cerebral palsy or identifying trazodone exposure[29, 26, 2, 22].

4.4 转移到保留的临床概念Transfer to held-out clinical concepts

基础模型应该支持预训练期间未枚举的下游任务。 因此，我们根据保留的概念协议评估 CLEF。我们随机抽取 20% 基准任务并从跨模式对齐中删除其相应的临床概念 在重新训练模型之前：从结构化 EHR 输入中排除匹配的 EHR 代码，并且 匹配的报告派生术语将从报告目标中删除。保留的任务不是 在表示学习期间使用，并且仅在冻结时的探测时引入 使用与第 1 节中相同的协议来探测患者级嵌入Foundation models should support downstream tasks that are not enumerated during pretraining. We therefore evaluate CLEF under a held-out concept protocol. We randomly select 20% of the benchmark tasks and remove their corresponding clinical concepts from cross-modal alignment before retraining the model: matching EHR codes are excluded from the structured EHR input, and matching report-derived terms are scrubbed from the report targets. The held-out tasks are not used during representation learning and are introduced only at probing time, when frozen patient-level embeddings are probed using the same protocol as in Section4.2.

表Table1显示 CLEF 转移到保留概念，并且在 45 个保留任务中没有降级。 这表明 CLEF 不依赖于对齐过程中特定任务的暴露来获得强大的下游性能，并且可以推广到新的临床概念，这表明它学习了临床脑电图的广泛可转移的表示。shows that CLEF transfers to held-out concepts with no degradation across the 45 held-out tasks. This indicates that CLEF does not rely on task-specific exposure during alignment to get strong downstream performance and can generalize to novel clinical concepts, suggesting that it learns a broadly transferable representation of clinical EEG.

总之，这些结果表明 CLEF 目前受到模型和数据规模的限制，而缩放任一轴都是获得进一步收益的有希望的方向。附录中提供了通道数和记录长度的进一步稳健性分析Together, these results indicate that CLEF is currently limited by both model and data scale, and that scaling either axis is a promising direction for further gains. Further robustness analyses for channel count and recording length are provided in AppendixG.

5 结论Conclusion

我们提出了 CLEF，一种基于临床的长上下文 EEG 基础模型，通过将多锥度频谱图标记上的会话规模掩模图像建模与神经科医生报告和结构化 EHR 数据的跨模式对齐相结合来学习患者级别的表示。 CLEF 对超过 10 万名患者进行了培训，并在 234 项任务的临床基准上进行了评估，在 234 项任务中的 229 项上优于之前的 EEG 基础模型，并可推广到未见过的概念和外部队列。这些结果将全会话、基于临床的表征学习确立为临床脑电图的可行基础模型范式。 局限性包括缺乏实时支持、学习睡眠架构的时间窗口不足以及可解释性有限；我们在附录中讨论了这些和其他考虑因素，以及更广泛的社会影响We presented CLEF, a clinically-grounded long-context EEG foundation model that learns patient-level representations by combining session-scale masked image modeling over multitaper spectrogram tokens with cross-modal alignment to neurologist reports and structured EHR data. Trained on over 100k patients and evaluated on a 234-task clinical benchmark, CLEF outperforms prior EEG foundation models on 229 of 234 tasks, and generalize to unseen concepts and external cohorts. These results establish full-session, clinically grounded representation learning as a viable foundation-model paradigm for clinical EEG. Limitations include lack of real-time support, insufficient time-window for learning sleep architecture, and limited interpretability; we discuss these and additional considerations, along with broader societal impacts, in AppendixA。 我们希望 CLEF 引起人们对全长脑电图记录中锁定的诊断价值的关注，并鼓励在这个方向上的进一步发展。. We hope CLEF draws attention to the diagnostic value locked within full-length EEG recordings and encourages further development in this direction.

附录AAppendix A讨论Discussion

A.1 局限性Limitations

缺乏实时支持。Lack of Real-time Support.CLEF 将整个 EEG 会话总结为单个患者级向量。在临床环境中，脑电图通常用于监测实时事件，例如手术期间的镇静情况。 CLEF 框架不适用于此类实时场景，不应用作实时监控系统。CLEF summarizes an entire EEG session as a single patient-level vector. In clinical settings, EEG is often used to monitor real-time events such as sedation during surgery. The CLEF framework is not intended for such real-time scenarios and should not be used as a real-time monitoring system.

上下文窗口。Context Window.虽然该模型是在 20 分钟的上下文窗口上进行训练的，该窗口明显大于之前的工作，但临床 EEG 会议可能需要更大的上下文窗口来捕获更长的时间尺度动态，例如完整睡眠架构或多天 cEEG 趋势。While the model is trained on 20-minute context windows that are significantly larger than those of prior work, clinical EEG sessions may require even larger context windows to capture longer-timescale dynamics such as full sleep architecture or multi-day cEEG trends.

可解释性。Interpretability.CLEF 的嵌入不能直接解释。我们不提供将特定时间段、通道或频段与嵌入维度或下游预测联系起来的归因机制，这可能会限制在需要解释特定发现的环境中的临床采用。开发这样的归因机制是未来工作的一个重要方向，特别是对于临床采用。CLEF’s embeddings are not directly interpretable. We do not provide attribution mechanisms linking specific time segments, channels, or frequency bands to embedding dimensions or downstream predictions, which may limit clinical adoption in settings that require explanation of specific findings. Developing such attribution mechanisms is an important direction for future work, particularly for clinical adoption.

A.2 更广泛的影响Broader Impacts

积极的社会影响。Positive Societal Impacts.产生患者级表征的临床脑电图基础模型有可能大大扩展专家级脑电图解释的机会。 CLEF 可以在神经生理学专业知识匮乏的资源贫乏的卫生系统中充当决策支持层，帮助实现专家级评估的民主化。除了直接解释支持之外，基于临床语义的患者级脑电图表示可以加速生物标志物的发现，这些疾病的脑电图相关性被怀疑但在规模上表征不佳，并能够预测神经系统和精神疾病的治疗反应，帮助临床医生个性化治疗并减少患者承担的试错负担。Clinical EEG foundation models that produce patient-level representations have the potential to substantially expand access to expert-level EEG interpretation. CLEF could serve as a decision-support layer in under-resourced health systems where neurophysiology expertise is scarce, helping to democratize access to specialist-level assessment. Beyond direct interpretation support, patient-level EEG representations grounded in clinical semantics could accelerate biomarker discovery for conditions whose EEG correlates are suspected but poorly characterized at scale, and enable treatment-response prediction across neurological and psychiatric disorders, helping clinicians personalize therapy and reducing the trial-and-error burden borne by patients.

负面社会影响。Negative Societal Impacts.部署临床脑电图基础模型也存在很大的风险。 由于 CLEF 的表示与临床报告和 EHR 数据一致，因此它们可以编码和传播与当地患者人口统计、记录设备、文档实践和历史诊断不足模式相关的分布偏差。因此，对于代表性不足的人群或偏离训练分布的临床环境，预测可能系统性不太准确或校准不佳。自动化偏差是另一个问题：临床医生可能会过度依赖模型输出，特别是在置信度校准不佳的罕见情况下，或者模型预测与脑电图既定临床使用不相符的任务中。因此，我们将 CLEF 视为增强而不是取代专家解释的工具。前瞻性验证、亚组公平性审核、仔细沟通不确定性以及明确界定预期用途是任何临床部署的先决条件。Deploying a clinical EEG foundation model also carries meaningful risks. Because CLEF’s representations are aligned with clinical reports and EHR data, they can encode and propagate distributional biases tied to local patient demographics, recording equipment, documentation practices, and patterns of historical under-diagnosis. As a result, predictions may be systematically less accurate or less well-calibrated for underrepresented populations or for clinical settings that diverge from the training distribution. Automation bias is a further concern: clinicians may over-rely on model outputs, particularly for rare conditions where confidence is poorly calibrated, or for tasks where model predictions do not correspond to an established clinical use of EEG. We therefore view CLEF as a tool to augment, not replace, expert interpretation. Prospective validation, subgroup fairness auditing, careful communication of uncertainty, and clear delineation of intended use are prerequisites to any clinical deployment.

附录BAppendix B基于 LLM 的预处理细节LLM-based Preprocessing Details

B.1 法学硕士摘要LLM Summarizer

在对齐之前，我们使用法学硕士摘要器对每份报告进行预处理。总结提示和输出标记长度会对保留多少临床内容产生重大影响，因此我们通过自动 QA 一致性管道选择两者。表中列出了管道中使用的问题集We preprocess each report with an LLM summarizer before alignment. The summarization prompt and output token length materially affects how much clinical content is preserved, so we select both via the automated QA-consistency pipeline. The question set used in the pipeline is listed in Table5。 Qwen-32B. Qwen-32B[42, 34]用于法学硕士。is used for the LLM.

提示候选人。Prompt candidates.候选总结提示是由法学硕士在脑电图专家的指导下生成的，他们提供了参考示例并指定提示应优先考虑临床显着内容（异常、背景活动、癫痫样特征、睡眠结构）而不是样板文件（电极放置、时间戳、程序注释）。表Candidate summarization prompts were generated by an LLM under guidance from EEG specialists, who provided reference examples and specified that prompts should prioritize clinically salient content (abnormalities, background activity, epileptiform features, sleep architecture) over boilerplate (electrode placements, timestamps, procedural notes). TableLABEL:tab:prompt_ablation报告针对最佳和最坏情况范围的几个示例候选者的 QA 一致性分数：最佳情况范围将每个原始报告与其自身配对（完美的内容保留），而最坏情况范围则用从其他患者采样的内容替换每个报告（仅捕获整个语料库中结果的基本率共现）。得分最高的提示（#1）用于后续训练。reports QA-consistency scores for several example candidates against best- and worst-case bounds: the best-case bound pairs each raw report with itself (perfect content preservation), while the worst-case bound replaces each report with content sampled from other patients (capturing only base-rate co-occurrence of findings across the corpus). The top-scoring prompt (#1) is used in subsequent training.

令牌长度。Token length.保持选定的提示固定，我们消除输出标记长度（表Holding the selected prompt fixed, we ablate the output token length (Table7）。性能峰值为 256 个代币；较短的输出会丢失临床细节，而较长的输出则会重新引入样板文件，而不会改善可恢复的内容。我们采用 256 个标记作为训练的摘要长度。). Performance peaks at 256 tokens; shorter outputs lose clinical detail, while longer outputs reintroduce boilerplate without improving recoverable content. We adopt 256 tokens as the summarization length for our training.

B.2 基准处理详细信息Benchmark Processing Details

电子病历表。EHR Tables.从电子健康记录数据中提取药物标签和疾病标签以创建建议的基准。使用 LLM 和 RxNorm ATC 代码 API 处理 EHR 数据中的药物名称并转换为 ATC 代码。药物提取分为住院和门诊两种情况。对于住院期间的脑电图记录，只有在记录后 1 天内完成的药物事件才被包含为阳性标签。对于门诊患者，记录时有效的任何药物处方都被列为阳性标签。重要的是，我们排除了所有“PRN”或“按需服用”的药物处方。 疾病标签提取分为慢性病和非慢性病。慢性疾病可以在脑电图记录之前的 EHR 中的任何时间点出现，而非慢性疾病最多需要在记录之前一周出现。 ICD-10 代码源自遭遇诊断和患者问题列表，并且在会话记录之前需要出现至少两个具有相同 ICD-10 代码（在不同日期）的遭遇诊断或问题列表中的一个，以满足积极标签的要求。然后将 ICD-10 代码分组为 Phecode，以代表临床上重要的表型。 测试或验证集中阳性标签少于 15 个的下游任务被丢弃。Medication labels and disease labels were extracted from Electronic Health Record data to create the proposed benchmark. The medication names from the EHR data were processed and converted to ATC codes using LLMs and RxNorm ATC code API. Medication extraction was split into in-patient and out-patient settings. For EEG recordings during in-patient setting, only medication events that were completed within 1 day of the recording were included as positive labels. For out-patient setting, any medication prescriptions that were active at the time of the recording were included as positive labels. Importantly, we exclude all medication prescriptions that were “PRN”, or “take as needed”. Disease label extraction was split into chronic and non-chronic diseases. Chronic diseases could appear at any point in the EHR prior to the EEG recording, while non-chronic diseases need to have appeared at most one week prior to the recording. ICD-10 codes were sourced from the encounter diagnoses and patient problem lists, and at least two encounter diagnoses with the same ICD-10 code (on different days) or one from the problem list needed to appear prior to the session recording to satisfy a positive label. The ICD-10 codes were then grouped into Phecodes to represent clinically significant phenotypes. Downstream tasks with fewer than 15 positive labels in the test or validation set were discarded.

临床报告。Clinical Reports.临床报告还包含有关脑电图特征、药物、疾病和诊断的信息。为了从临床报告中提取特征，法学硕士被提示回答报告中是否包含某些特征，如下所示：Clinical reports also contained information regarding EEG features, medications, diseases and diagnoses. To extract features from the clinical report, an LLM was prompted to answer whether or not certain features were contained in the report, as follows:“根据报告，脑电图检查是否包含 XXX？如果报告说存在，请回答 1。如果报告说不存在，请回答 0。如果报告未提及或不确定，请回答 -1。请提供答案的理由。”"According to the report, does the EEG session contain XXX ? If report says it is present, answer 1. If report says it is not present, answer 0. If report does not mention it or unsure, answer -1. Please provide the reasoning for your answer."未提及事件的情况将被丢弃，以便在报告明确指出某个功能不存在时保留负类。 Hermes 2 Pro 改装版 Llama-3-8BCases where an event is not mentioned are discarded, to preserve negatives class for when report explicitly states that a feature is not present. Hermes 2 Pro tuned version of Llama-3-8B[35]用于回答问题，以强制结构化输出。 使用如下提示从报告中以列表格式提取药物、疾病和诊断：was used for the question answering, to enforce structured output. Medications, diseases, and diagnoses were extracted from the report in list format using a prompt as follows:“列出报告中提到的所有XXX。不要解释，只是列出。如果没有提到，请回答没有。”"List all XXX mentioned in the report. Do not explain, just list. If none are mentioned, answer none."然后对结果进行过滤、处理，并通过法学硕士将其分组为类似于 EHR 疾病标签的 Phecode。如果临床报告的任务与 EHR 的任务重叠，则首选基于下游的临床报告。The results were then filtered, processed, and grouped with an LLM into Phecodes similar to the EHR disease labels. In the case where tasks from the clinical reports were overlapping with those from the EHR, the clinical report based downstream was preferred.

脑电图谱。EEG Spectrogram.以 200 Hz 采样的信号通过零相位 IIR 滤波器在 0.1 至 75 Hz 之间进行带通滤波，并通过陷波滤波器在 60 Hz 和高达奈奎斯特频率的谐波下抑制线路噪声。 每个通道均通过多锥 STFT 使用 4 秒窗口（800 个样本）和步幅为 0.625 s（125 个样本）转换为时频表示。 光谱浓度由具有时间半带宽积的 DPSS 锥体控制Signals sampled at 200 Hz were bandpass-filtered between 0.1 and 75 Hz with a zero-phase IIR filter, and line noise was suppressed with notch filters at 60 Hz and harmonics up to the Nyquist frequency. Each channel was converted to a time–frequency representation via multitaper STFT using a 4-second window (800 samples) with a stride of 0.625 s (125 samples). Spectral concentration was controlled by DPSS tapers with time-halfbandwidth productN​W=2.0NW=2.0, 保留, retainingK=3K=3在低偏差标准下逐渐减小（特征值tapers under a low-bias criterion (eigenvalue>0.9>0.9）。 多锥度功率谱计算为跨锥度的 FFT 幅度平方的特征值加权平均值，通过锥度权重和采样率进行归一化，然后通过以下方式转换为分贝：). The multitaper power spectrum was computed as the eigenvalue-weighted average of squared FFT magnitudes across tapers, normalized by taper weights and sampling rate, then converted to decibels via10​log10⁡P10\log_{10}P。频率仓. 脑电图编码器。EEG Encoder.EEG 编码器是视觉变压器 (ViT)。我们实验了三种模型尺度：CLEF-Small（深度 4，隐藏维度 512，8 个注意力头）、CLEF-Base（深度 12，隐藏维度 512，8 个注意力头）和 CLEF-Large（深度 20，隐藏维度 768，12 个注意力头），全部使用 MLP 比率 4、具有 GELU 激活、flash 注意力和 dropout 0.1 的预规范 Transformer 块。 每个 1280 秒的 EEG 记录都被标记为离散 VQGAN 标记的网格，并同时进行修补，其中每个原始频谱图修补都被线性投影并添加到其相应的标记嵌入中，从而产生 2048 个标记的序列。 较短的会话是右填充的，并且掩盖了自我注意力和重建损失。 可学习的代理令牌被添加到序列之前并给出其自己的位置嵌入；其投影表示随后在解码器中用于代替丢弃和屏蔽的位置。 在训练期间，标记按照截断高斯分布进行掩码The EEG encoder is a Vision Transformer (ViT). We experiment with three model scales: CLEF-Small (depth 4, hidden dimension 512, 8 attention heads), CLEF-Base (depth 12, hidden dimension 512, 8 attention heads), and CLEF-Large (depth 20, hidden dimension 768, 12 attention heads), all using MLP ratio 4, pre-norm Transformer blocks with GELU activation, flash attention, and dropout 0.1. Each 1280-second EEG recording is tokenized into a grid of discrete VQGAN tokens and simultaneously patchified, where each raw spectrogram patch is linearly projected and added to its corresponding token embedding, yielding sequences of 2048 tokens. Shorter sessions are right-padded and masked from self-attention and reconstruction loss. A learnable proxy token is prepended to the sequence and given its own positional embedding; its projected representation is later used in the decoder to stand in for dropped and masked positions. During training, tokens are masked following a truncated Gaussian distribution over[0.25,1.0][0.25,1.0]与withμ=0.55\mu=0.55和andσ=0.15\sigma=0.15; rdrop=0.25r_{\text{drop}}=0.25的标记被丢弃，而剩余的屏蔽标记被替换为可学习的屏蔽嵌入。编码器输出通过所有有效保留令牌的均值池进行聚合。of tokens are dropped, while the remaining masked tokens are replaced with a learnable mask embedding. The encoder output is aggregated via mean pooling over all valid kept tokens.

脑电图解码器。EEG Decoder.解码器是深度为 4、隐藏维度为 512、8 个注意力头、MLP 比率为 4 以及具有 GELU 激活和 dropout 0.1 的预范数块的 Transformer。丢弃的和屏蔽的令牌都被解码器中的投影代理令牌表示替换，并且所有位置都被赋予可学习的全序列位置嵌入。The decoder is a Transformer with depth 4, hidden dimension 512, 8 attention heads, MLP ratio 4, and pre-norm blocks with GELU activation and dropout 0.1. Both dropped and masked tokens are replaced by the projected proxy token representation in the decoder, and all positions are given a learnable full-sequence positional embedding.

报告编码器。Report Encoder.报告编码器使用两阶段架构处理总结的临床脑电图报告。首先，一个冻结的 T5-v1.1-Base 编码器（The report encoder processes the summarized clinical EEG reports using a two-stage architecture. First, a frozen T5-v1.1-Base encoder (768768-维隐藏状态）从标记化到最大长度的报告中提取标记级特征-dimensional hidden states) extracts token-level features from reports tokenized to a maximum length of256256令牌，在训练期间不接收梯度更新。结果序列线性投影到共享嵌入维度tokens, which receives no gradient updates during training. A final layer norm is applied, and the sequence is aggregated into a single512512通过非填充令牌上的均值池进行维度嵌入。-dimensional embedding via mean pooling over non-padding tokens.

电子病历编码器。EHR Encoder.EHR 编码器将患者临床元数据表示为输入 Transformer 的可变长度令牌序列。 每个患者的人口统计数据通过三个可学习的嵌入表独立嵌入：年龄被离散成 10 个十年范围的箱（0-9 到 90-100 岁）加上一个 N/A 标记（总共 11 个条目）；性别有 3 个类别（F、M、未知）；种族/民族有 8 个类别（美洲印第安人或阿拉斯加原住民、亚洲人、黑人或非裔美国人、多种族、夏威夷原住民或其他太平洋岛民、其他种族、白人、不可用）。 病情和药物均由一个可学习的嵌入表表示，分别涵盖 178 种疾病类别和 205 种药物类别。 对于每个患者，病情和药物序列由在记录时相应类别为阳性或活动的嵌入组成。 条件和药物序列被截断并补零，分别为 30 和 50 个标记的固定长度。 由此产生的 83 个标记（3 个人口统计标记、30 个条件标记、50 个药物标记）被连接并通过具有 8 个注意力头、预规范层标准化和 GELU 激活的 4 层 Transformer 编码器。应用最后一层范数，并且对非填充令牌进行均值池化，生成单个 512 维 EHR 嵌入。The EHR encoder represents patient clinical metadata as a variable-length token sequence fed into a Transformer. Each patient’s demographics are embedded independently via three learnable embedding tables: age is discretized into 10 decade-wide bins (0–9 through 90–100 years) plus one N/A token (11 entries total); sex has 3 categories (F, M, Unknown); and race/ethnicity has 8 categories (American Indian or Alaska Native, Asian, Black or African American, Multiracial, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, Other Race, White, Unavailable). Conditions and medications are each represented by a single learnable embedding table, covering 178 disease categories and 205 medication categories respectively. For each patient, the condition and medication sequences consist of the embeddings whose corresponding categories are positive or active at the time of recording. Condition and medication sequences are truncated and zero-padded to fixed lengths of 30 and 50 tokens respectively. The resulting 83 tokens (3 demographic, 30 condition, 50 medication tokens) are concatenated and passed through a 4-layer Transformer encoder with 8 attention heads, pre-norm layer normalization, and GELU activations. A final layer norm is applied, and mean pooling over non-padded tokens produces a single 512-dimensional EHR embedding.

The model is optimized with AdamW (β1=0.9\beta_{1}=0.9, β2=0.95\beta_{2}=0.95, 重量衰减, weight decay=0.1=0.1），基础学习率为) at a base learning rate of1×10−31\times 10^{-3}（有效学习率(effective learning rate5×10−45\times 10^{-4}对于批量大小 128），在 1 纪元线性预热后进行余弦衰减。训练运行 20 个 epoch，在 4 个 NVIDIA L40S GPU 上花费大约 20 小时。 EMA 平滑权重（衰减for batch size 128), with cosine decay following a 1-epoch linear warmup. Training runs for 20 epochs, taking approximately 20 hours on 4 NVIDIA L40S GPUs. EMA-smoothed weights (decay=0.9999=0.9999) 用于推理。) are used at inference.

下游探测。Downstream Probing.编码器被冻结，其输出随时间汇集以创建单个 512 维（对于 CLEF-Large 为 768 维）嵌入。然后使用中间维度为 1536 的 2 层 MLP 探测该嵌入 5 个时期，学习率为The encoder is frozen and its output is pooled across time to create a single 512-dimensional (or 768-dimensional for CLEF-Large) embedding. This embedding is then probed using a 2 layer MLP with intermediate dimension of size 1536 for 5 epochs, with learning rate of1×10−41\times 10^{-4}。每个任务都有一个独立的探测头。在训练期间，从文件中随机抽取 1280 秒的片段。在验证过程中，会话被分成大小为 1280 秒的窗口，并且所有编码器输出都跨会话进行池化，以生成要探测的单个嵌入。该模型使用 AdamW 进行优化，具有权重衰减. Each task has an independent probing head. During training, a random 1280-second segment was sampled from a file. During validation, the session was chunked into windows of size 1280 seconds, and all encoder outputs were pooled across sessions to yield a single embedding to probe. The model is optimized with AdamW, with weight decay=0.01=0.01。为每个任务选择最佳验证时期，然后进行评估。所有基线均以相同的方式汇集和探测。每个任务重复 4 次，并计算并提供每个任务的标准偏差。. Best validation epoch was chosen for each task and then evaluate on. All baselines were pooled and probed in identical manner. Each task was repeated 4 times and standard deviations were calculated and provided for each.

We attribute this to a shortcut effect: the VQGAN tokenizer computes each discrete code from a spatial context, so the continuous patches co-located with a masked position can leak information about its token target, making local reconstruction easier and reducing pressure on the encoder to learn globally predictive representations.

两个调整目标都有贡献（表Both alignment objectives contribute (Table13).删除任一Removing eitherℒReport\mathcal{L}_{\text{Report}} or ℒEHR\mathcal{L}_{\text{EHR}}AUC 下降（分别为 0.7279 和 0.7264，两者均为 0.7384）。这两种损失实际上可以互相帮助优化：在两者都存在的情况下，收敛验证损失低于单独训练其中任何一个时的损失（drops AUC (0.7279 and 0.7264 respectively, vs. 0.7384 with both). 预训练事项（表Pretraining matters (Table13).删除阶段 I（“无阶段 I”）会使 AUC 从 0.7384 下降到 0.7134，并且收敛对齐损失要严重得多（1.780 和 3.432 vs. 1.347 和 3.110）。因此，掩蔽建模为第二阶段提供了比随机初始化更好的起点。Removing Stage I (“w/o Stage I”) drops AUC from 0.7384 to 0.7134, and the converged alignment losses are substantially worse (1.780 and 3.432 vs. 1.347 and 3.110). Masked modeling thus gives Stage II a meaningfully better starting point than random initialization.

D.5 培训计划Training Scheme

连续节拍关节（表Sequential beats joint (Table14).培训TrainingℒRecon\mathcal{L}_{\text{Recon}}和andℒAlign\mathcal{L}_{\text{Align}}从头开始联合产生 0.7226，明显低于顺序管道的 0.7384。将联合运行扩展到更长的训练并不能缩小差距（0.7214），排除了训练不足的原因，并支持我们的解释，即当从未初始化的编码器同时优化时，两个目标会发生干扰。jointly from scratch yields 0.7226, noticeably below the 0.7384 of the sequential pipeline. Extending the joint run to longer training does not close the gap (0.7214), ruling out undertraining as the cause and supporting our interpretation that the two objectives interfere when optimized simultaneously from an uninitialized encoder.

在第二阶段保留重建没有帮助（表Retaining reconstruction in Stage II does not help (Table14).保管KeepingℒRecon\mathcal{L}_{\text{Recon}}第二阶段的对齐损失与连续基线 (0.7381) 相关，并且提高掩蔽比不会改变图像 (0.7371, 0.7375)。因此，我们在第二阶段默认使用没有重建项的顺序管道。alongside the alignment losses during Stage II is tied with the sequential baseline (0.7381), and raising the masking ratio does not change the picture (0.7371, 0.7375). We therefore default to the sequential pipeline with no reconstruction term in Stage II.

附录GAppendix G稳健性分析Robustness Analyses

我们分析通道数和记录长度如何影响表示质量。所有消融报告均表示 AUROC 对具有相同种子的 234 个基准任务进行平均。We analyze how channel count and recording length affect representation quality. All ablations report mean AUROC averaged over the 234 benchmark tasks with the same seed.

通道数。Channel Count.由于下游部署可以访问的通道数少于完整的 10-20 个蒙太奇，因此我们在探测时使用逐渐变小的通道子集来评估预训练的 42M 模型，从而屏蔽掉不可用的通道：1 ch (C4)； 3 通道（F4、C4、O2），AASM 推荐的 PSG 蒙太奇Because downstream deployments may have access to fewer channels than the full 10–20 montage, we evaluate the pre-trained 42M model with progressively smaller channel subsets at probing time, masking out the unavailable channels: 1 ch (C4); 3 ch (F4, C4, O2), the AASM-recommended PSG montage[3]; 6 通道（F3、F4、C3、C4、O1、O2）； 12 通道（Fp1、Fp2、F3、F4、C3、C4、P3、P4、O1、O2、T3、T4）；和 19 频道（完整的 10-20 蒙太奇）。如表所示; 6 ch (F3, F4, C3, C4, O1, O2); 12 ch (Fp1, Fp2, F3, F4, C3, C4, P3, P4, O1, O2, T3, T4); and 19 ch (full 10–20 montage). As shown in Table16，性能从 1 到 3 个通道以及从 3 到 6 个通道急剧上升，然后趋于稳定，这表明大多数临床相关内容可以从 AASM PSG 蒙太奇中恢复，并且 CLEF 表示在低通道部署中仍然有用。, performance rises sharply from 1 to 3 channels and from 3 to 6 channels, then plateaus, suggesting that most clinically relevant content is recoverable from the AASM PSG montage and that CLEF representations remain useful in low-channel deployments.

录音长度。Recording Length.为了评估记录持续时间对患者表征质量的影响，我们在探测时将记录修剪为各种最大长度，并重新评估预先训练的 42M 模型。如表所示To assess the effect of recording duration on patient representation quality, we trim recordings to various maximum lengths at probing time and re-evaluate the pre-trained 42M model. As shown in Table17，AUROC 随着可用记录长度单调提高，从 6 分钟时的 0.7065 上升到整个会话的 0.7354，在短持续时间时增益最大。这种模式与获取大约 20 分钟的常规脑电图的临床实践一致。它还表明 CLEF 表示在短录音下会正常降级，支持全长会话不可用的设置。, AUROC improves monotonically with available recording length, rising from 0.7065 at 6 minutes to 0.7354 with the full session, with gains largest at short durations. This pattern is consistent with the clinical practice of acquiring routine EEGs of approximately 20 minutes. It also indicates that CLEF representations degrade gracefully under short recordings, supporting the settings where full-length sessions are not available.
